overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong, highly specialized professional presence across Bluesky, LinkedIn, and Mastodon. His content effectively reaches academic and research-oriented communities, driving high engagement rates on research updates, tool releases, and recruitment opportunities. While LinkedIn provides the highest absolute engagement due to a larger follower base, Bluesky commands the highest average engagement rate, indicating a highly active and responsive peer network.

contentThemes.description: Updates on research, methodology, and software tools (like CooRnet v2.0) designed to detect coordinated link-sharing and disinformation campaigns.
Recruitment posts for postdoctoral and PhD positions in computational social science, which drive strong sharing and interaction.
Announcements of newly published papers, research grants, and upcoming conference presentations.

recommendations: Capitalize on the highly active Bluesky audience by sharing more frequent, informal progress updates and behind-the-scenes insights into ongoing research.
Diversify LinkedIn content by publishing shorter, high-impact key findings from newly funded projects to engage industry practitioners and policy makers who may not read academic papers.
Introduce interactive elements, such as questions or discussion prompts in Mastodon posts, to foster more peer-to-peer conversations within the specialized aoir.social instance.

platformInsights.bluesky: Acts as the most dynamically engaging platform (average 6.14% engagement rate), where research-related posts and student opportunities are shared heavily through reposts, indicating high peer alignment.
platformInsights.mastodon: Provides a highly technical audience (average 4.55% engagement rate) suitable for tool-specific updates, though post volume and raw interaction numbers remain lower compared to other platforms.
platformInsights.linkedin: Serves as the primary channel for high-profile professional milestones like grant announcements and job openings, bringing in the highest total engagement volume (180 total interactions) due to its larger reach.
